subject: history_social
passage: Roman engineers laid their main roads in several layers of stone and gravel, which gave each road a firm base that did not sink in wet weather. ______ they built the surface of the road slightly higher in the middle than at the edges, so that rainwater ran off into ditches at the sides instead of collecting in puddles.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The first sentence describes one feature of Roman roads: their layered base. The second sentence describes another, separate feature: a surface raised in the middle to shed rain. A transition that adds a further point is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Instead" would mean the engineers raised the middle of the road in place of laying layers, but they did both.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A raised surface is not an example of a layered base; it is a different feature.
explanation.C: Correct. "In addition" adds a second feature of Roman road building to the first one.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The second feature does not contrast with the first; both help the roads stand up to wet weather.
